newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ConsRutile says has issue shortfall.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ConsRutile says has issue shortfall.

text.p: Consolidated Rutile Ltd said on Friday it had a six percent shortfall in its 19-for-10 rights issue of 113.4 million shares to raise about A$96.7 million.

"Under the terms of the underwriting agreement dated 9th December 1996 between the company and RGC Ltd, RGC Ltd will subscribe for the shares comprising the rights issue shortfall," Consolidated Rutile said.
RGC is 50.1 percent owned by Cudgen RZ Ltd, which in turn is about 77 percent owned by RGC. At 3.15 p.m. (0415 GMT), Consolidated Rutile shares were one cent down at 86 cents.
